continuity_scope: Gothic's 2001 English Windows release as witnessed by its English Xicat Interactive/Piranha Bytes manual. This separate localization/release witness is not treated as interchangeable with the original German Shoebox/Egmont edition, current GOG-maintained builds, the 2023 Switch port, the Gothic remake, sequels, expansions/mods, or later localizations.
work_or_witnesses: Gothic English Rulebook/Manual, credited to Xicat Interactive and Piranha Bytes; Windows 98/2000/ME/XP requirements
GOG Gothic product page, Piranha Bytes/THQ Nordic company/current-build boundary only
Gothic German manual, ©2001 Egmont Interactive/Piranha Bytes/Shoebox, edition/localization boundary only
coverage_rule: All individually named dramatic agents directly role/action-profiled in the English manual's Story section: King Rhotbar, Gomez, Lares, and Y’Berion. The manual does not call the player character 'Nameless Hero'; it says only that 'another convict is thrown into the Barrier,' so no title-designated player-character record is made. Unnamed 12 Mages, Fire/Water Mages, prisoners, guards, camp members, generic roles, animals/monsters, and all names not profile-backed in this witness are excluded.
omissions: The player-controlled convict: the exact English Story witness leaves the person unnamed and no stable title-designation is supplied. Player skill, magic, equipment, trainer, camp/faction, dialogue, combat, and quest choices remain variable attributes, not a record.
All individually named people not directly role/action-profiled by the selected 20-page manual, including direct-game NPCs absent from its Story and Who’s Who summaries.
Camps/factions, guilds, classes, monster kinds, magic circles, items, places, the Barrier, the King’s letter, and mechanics as character nodes.

Original German/other localized text, current GOG updates and added localizations, ports, Gothic II/III and expansions, mods, 2023 Switch release, the remake, teaser/prototype, adaptations, fan wikis, Wikipedia, walkthroughs, and databases.
uncertainties: The English manual is accessed through a non-rightsholder archive. It bears internal Xicat Interactive/Piranha Bytes credits and proprietary-rights text, but host authorization, scan provenance, OCR fidelity, and exact retail-edition equivalence remain uncertain; claims are restricted to clear page-specific wording.
The manual spells the king 'Rhotbar'. This record preserves that witness spelling rather than silently normalizing it from another localization, sequel, or community source.

The story presents historical setup and camps, not a complete named NPC directory, dialogue archive, faction-choice matrix, or ending transcript. Pass completion is only against its stated manual profile rule.

GOG's current package lists current languages and 2025 changes, including added localizations/Union integration. It is used to demarcate the maintained release from the selected manual witness, not to add original 2001 claims.

The manual shows protagonists can spend learning points through trainers and join/operate around camp systems, but it gives no universal player faction, skill build, quest outcome, or spoiler conclusion.
evidence_basis: Primary original-game documentation (English manual) with Piranha Bytes/Xicat credits; current THQ Nordic-associated GOG product information and the German 2001 manual serve only edition/localization-boundary context. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, walkthrough, community database, or uncredited guide is canonical evidence.
